column1: # One row per national identifier type (the -input slug without its suffix): validated (a function in shared/national-identifiers.ts), no-check (the scheme has no usable check, with the reason) or open (not done yet).
# bin/check-identifier-validation fails when a type is missing or listed twice, a validator is not exported or claimed, or a no-check row has no reason.

column3: Numbers issued since October 2020 carry no valid check digit, so the old check would flag genuine numbers.
The check-digit algorithm is not published (the component documentation says so), so only a date rule could be checked.
